name: Réde (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Réde (a red shield with a white bird and a green mound) within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed RÉDE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Réde arms with wreath and scroll
